newsitem.title: TOGO: Tens of thousands march to support Togo president.
newsitem.headline: Tens of thousands march to support Togo president.

text.p: Tens of thousands of people marched through Togo's capital Lome on Sunday in support of its veteran president Gnassingbe Eyadema, witnesses said.
Members of the central committee of Eyadema's Togolese People's Rally political party led the march for "unity, peace and the relaunch of the economy in support of the government".

Eyadema is a contemporary of embattled president Mobutu Sese Seko, another African strongman who seized power shortly after independence, and helped bring Zaire's warring faction together in his capital Lome in March.
"This march calls for social cohesion -- to move away from suspicions, nastiness and all negative points of view," said Prime Minister Kwassi Klutse, representing Eyadema.
Klutse said the march was not in response to an opposition protest aobut security on Saturday.
Eyadema steered his way through foreign-inspired democratic reforms in the early 1990s and despite violent street protests and cries of foul from the opposition, he kept his grip on power.
